rules.statement: A deed of gift can be revoked with the intervention of Court on ingratitude on the part of the donee.
rules.supporting_quote: However, under the Roman Dutch law, which is our common law, such a deed of gift can be revoked with the intervention of Court inter alia on ingratitude on the part of the donee.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: sections 2 and 3 of the Revocation of Irrevocable Deeds of Gift on the Ground of Gross Ingratitude Act, No. 5 of 2017
